name: abyss-eater
description: Abyss Eater: Ocean Survival — server-authoritative 3D multiplayer fish survival on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && node --check dist/worker.mjs
scripts.deploy:game: npm run build && npm run render:production && npx --yes wrangler@4.129.1 deploy --config dist/wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:game && npm run deploy:gateway
